scope: Nonempty ▶-marked fields in official ExampleLanguage XML 2.0.212.31; excludes runtime C#, historyspice JSON, procedural syllable semantics, translations already wrong/mixed and strings absent from the official export. Coverage is field availability, not full-game translation quality.
mode: Incremental XML with Lang=CN; requires original CN pack and later load order.
collection_policy: Load=Replace collections include unchanged existing CN siblings to preserve the entire collection.
